Greenriver Town.description: A mortal town beneath the Azure Reed Sect, surrounded by rice terraces, spirit-herb gardens and the misty Jade River.
encounters: A wounded spirit fox watches from beneath a broken shrine.
A merchant argues that his spirit-stone crate was replaced with river rocks.
An old fisherman hears a bronze bell ringing below the river.
A group of outer disciples accuse a villager of stealing a medicinal herb.
A night-blooming spirit orchid opens beside an abandoned grave.
A traveling storyteller claims a sealed ruin has appeared in the eastern hills.
sense_hints: Several mortal life-signs cluster around the market and river docks.
The old city gate carries faint spiritual residue from years of cultivator traffic.

Cloudspine Foothills.description: Steep cedar forests and broken stone paths leading toward old cultivation caves and abandoned formation towers.
encounters: A damaged formation repeats the same birdsong every seven breaths.
Three iron-horn boars uproot spirit herbs near a cliff path.
A rival sect scouting party demands to know why you crossed their marker stones.
A cave entrance exhales cold spiritual mist despite the summer heat.
A sword embedded in a boulder hums when cultivators approach.
sense_hints: Thin formation fluctuations drift between the cliffs.
Spirit-beast auras appear and vanish among the higher ridges.

Moonfen Marsh.description: A dangerous wetland rich in medicinal plants, poisonous insects, ghost-lotus flowers and hidden alchemist camps.
encounters: Blue ghost-lotus petals drift upstream against the current.
A poisoned herb gatherer collapses near a stand of black reeds.
A giant marsh crane guards a patch of rare medicinal moss.
A masked alchemist offers to trade an unnamed pill for fresh beast blood.
Pale lights circle an old grave mound without casting reflections.
sense_hints: Water and Yin qi interfere with precise spiritual scanning.
Something beneath the mud occasionally disturbs the local spiritual current.

Golden Pavilion Auction House.description: A many-tiered auction pavilion protected by ancient formations and discreet hidden experts. Violence inside is forbidden; the protection ends at the front doors.

Azure Crown Imperial City.description: The capital of the dominant mortal dynasty, filled with noble clans, ministries, sect envoys and imperial guards. The city functions as a complete family starting region with local trade, cultivation resources, household politics, work, and recurring problems.
encounters: A steward from a local cultivation family asks for help with a succession dispute spilling into the streets.
The inner-city market is trading tribute goods, but a sudden shortage has pushed smaller shops into a bidding dispute.
A resource seeker claims a fresh cache of tribute goods has appeared beyond the safest streets and wants a partner.
Two junior cultivators from rival local households turn a routine disagreement in Azure Crown Imperial City into a public challenge.
A traveling artisan posts court commissions on the city notice board, offering payment, reputation, or family favor.
sense_hints: Thousands of mortal and cultivator auras overlap behind the capital formations.
Several guarded spiritual signatures move between the palace, clan districts and sect embassies.

Spirit Jade Capital.description: A vast Spiritual World capital built around a jade ley-line nexus where ascended sects and ancient families bargain for influence.
encounters: Ascended cultivators gather around a jade plaza where sect representatives recruit proven juniors.
An ancient family convoy arrives beneath a canopy of spirit banners and protective formations.
A formation scholar demonstrates a temporary qi array to a crowd of artisans.
Rumors spread that an underworld broker changed meeting places somewhere in the capital district.
A public law-stele flickers as several cultivators compare comprehension insights.
sense_hints: A jade ley-line nexus makes spiritual sense unusually vivid but crowded.
High-level auras are common enough here that individual experts are difficult to isolate.

Nine-Heavens Immortal Court.description: The central court of an Immortal World domain, suspended above immortal clouds and guarded by law formations.
encounters: Immortal clan delegates debate a territorial petition beneath floating law tablets.
A cloud-market convoy docks at the court and unloads rare immortal-grade materials.
Formation masters inspect damage to a public transit array linking distant domains.
An immortal official quietly asks for witnesses to a recent forbidden-art incident.
Cultivators gather at a star-viewing terrace to exchange rumors about secret realms and heavenly phenomena.
sense_hints: Immortal law formations layer space so densely that distant courtyards feel only a step apart.
The strongest auras are deliberately veiled by court etiquette and defensive arrays.

Celestial Mandate Palace.description: A palace-city at the heart of the Celestial World, where sovereign decrees can redirect the fate of entire star regions.
encounters: Celestial envoys arrive through a sovereign gate carrying decrees from distant star regions.
A heavenly market opens beneath a rotating constellation array for only a few hours.
Law cultivators gather around a mandate stele to debate the consequences of a recent cosmic omen.
A great clan requests neutral witnesses for negotiations that could alter several celestial territories.
The palace formations briefly resonate with a distant tribulation, drawing powerful cultivators into the plazas.
sense_hints: Sovereign law formations suppress hostile intent without dulling spiritual perception.
Countless celestial signatures overlap with traces of fate, law and ancient bloodlines.

Spirit Jade Rebirth Enclave.description: A protected lower district in the Spiritual World where mortal-born descendants, reincarnated souls and weak juniors can survive beneath stabilizing formations.
sense_hints: Layered formations soften the Spiritual World pressure around newborn souls.

Nine-Heavens Rebirth Terrace.description: A sheltered Immortal World terrace maintained for newborn clan members and reincarnated souls whose bodies have not yet rebuilt immortal cultivation.
sense_hints: Immortal qi is filtered through ancient cradle formations so fragile bodies are not destroyed.

Celestial Cradle Province.description: A rare Celestial World province protected by sovereign law formations, allowing reincarnated souls to begin again in mortal-strength bodies without being crushed by the realm itself.
sense_hints: The local laws bend gently around newborn souls, suppressing otherwise lethal celestial pressure.

Azure Cloud Mountain Gate.description: A white-stone stairway climbs through cloud-wrapped pines to the public mountain gate of the Azure Cloud Sect. Sword marks left by generations of applicants cover the testing plaza.

Crimson Furnace Valley.description: Red cliffs surround a furnace valley veined with fire-aspected qi. Herb terraces, pill halls and bronze examination furnaces mark the Crimson Furnace Sect recruitment grounds.

Frozen Moon Terrace.description: A high terrace above a cold mirror-lake where frost formations glow beneath moonstone tiles. Frozen Moon Palace tests patience, control and formation sense here.

Black Serpent Ravine.description: A humid ravine of black bamboo, beast pens and poison gardens. The Black Serpent Clan judges recruits by fieldcraft, nerve and their respect for dangerous creatures.

Blood River Gorge.description: A hidden gorge where iron-red water cuts through dark stone. Blood River banners appear only to those who have been shown the correct trail or survived long enough to be noticed.

Corpse Lantern Necropolis.description: A concealed funerary complex lit by blue soul-lanterns. Names of the dead are carved into black tablets while quiet archivists test whether visitors can face death without losing themselves.

netherworld_sacrificial_manual.description: A taboo sutra recording sacrificial exchanges of life, karma and power.

spirit_iron_armor.description: Layered spirit-iron plates etched with simple qi-dispersing channels.

talisman_paper.name: Spirit Talisman Paper
talisman_paper.description: Formation-treated paper that can hold a short-lived inscription.

spirit_ink.name: Spirit Ink
spirit_ink.description: Mineral-and-herb ink used for talismans, seals and formation inscriptions.

array_disk_blank.name: Blank Formation Disk
array_disk_blank.description: A reusable-looking but sacrificial formation substrate prepared for one deployed array.

swift_wind_talisman.name: Swift-Wind Talisman
swift_wind_talisman.description: A movement talisman that lightens the body and sharpens footwork for a short time.

stone_skin_talisman.name: Stone-Skin Talisman
stone_skin_talisman.description: A defensive talisman that reinforces flesh and steadies qi under impact.

spirit_focus_talisman.name: Spirit-Focus Talisman
spirit_focus_talisman.description: A meditation talisman that clears distracting qi patterns and sharpens insight.

effect.description: The inscription steadies spiritual perception and comprehension.

minor_qi_gathering_array_disk.name: Minor Qi-Gathering Array Disk
minor_qi_gathering_array_disk.description: A single-use deployment disk that creates a temporary shared qi-gathering formation at the current location.

minor_warding_array_disk.name: Minor Warding Array Disk
minor_warding_array_disk.description: A single-use deployment disk that creates a temporary shared defensive formation at the current location.

quests.title: Nine Cycles of Purification
quests.description: Refine the impurities left in your {realm} cultivation until only the purest qi remains.
quests.clue: Purity is gained by repeatedly discarding what is unworthy.

quests.title: Twelve Meridian Tempering
quests.description: Temper the major meridians so your {root} qi can circulate without hidden weakness.
quests.clue: A perfect vessel cannot have a single weak channel.

quests.title: A Worthy Opponent
quests.description: Seek pressure appropriate to a {path}; perfection needs adversity, not safe meditation alone.

quests.title: Heaven-and-Earth Resonance
quests.description: Find a place where natural qi resonates with your {root} spiritual root and comprehend its rhythm.
quests.clue: The world is the oldest cultivation manual.

quests.title: The Unbroken Foundation
quests.description: Repair hidden instabilities accumulated through the entire {realm} realm.
quests.clue: Perfection is often repair rather than accumulation.

quests.title: Heart Demon Reflection
quests.description: Confront an inner contradiction before it grows into a future heart demon.
quests.clue: A flaw denied becomes a chain.

quests.title: Touch the Realm Limit
quests.description: Compress body, qi, spirit and intent until you can sense the boundary mortals call impossible.
quests.clue: The final wall only appears after every lesser flaw is removed.

verdant_furnace_legacy.name: Verdant Furnace Legacy
verdant_furnace_legacy.description: A lost alchemical inheritance teaching medicinal harmony, flame restraint and adaptive pill formulas.

nine_echo_sword_legacy.name: Nine-Echo Sword Legacy
nine_echo_sword_legacy.description: Nine sword echoes that teach intent, timing and how one strike can contain many answers.

stygian_keeper_legacy.name: Stygian Keeper Legacy
stygian_keeper_legacy.description: A forbidden soul inheritance dealing with ghosts, corpse echoes and the boundary between life and death.

verdant_immortal_grotto.name: Verdant Immortal Grotto
verdant_immortal_grotto.description: A sealed medicinal grotto where an ancient alchemist cultivated a garden that has continued growing without sunlight.

rooms.name: The Door of Withered Vines
rooms.description: Dead vines awaken as a living formation and test whether intruders can read the flow of medicinal qi.

rooms.name: Frostfire Garden
rooms.description: Fire and ice spiritual plants grow intertwined while a territorial spirit beast sleeps among them.

rooms.name: Broken Pill Hall
rooms.description: Hundreds of failed pills litter the floor. The surviving furnace still contains a dangerous natural flame spark.

rooms.name: Verdant Inheritance Chamber
rooms.description: A jade furnace floats above a dry spiritual spring. The final trial asks whether the cultivator understands restraint rather than raw heat.

sword_grave_nine_echoes.name: Sword Grave of Nine Echoes
sword_grave_nine_echoes.description: A drifting graveyard of broken swords where every footstep returns as a blade-like echo.

rooms.name: Field of Broken Blades
rooms.description: Thousands of abandoned weapons resonate with hostile intent.

rooms.name: Echo Bridge
rooms.description: Invisible sword intent cuts across a narrow stone bridge in repeating patterns.

rooms.name: Hall of the Unswung Sword
rooms.description: The strongest pressure comes from a sword that has never once left its sheath.

rooms.name: Nine-Echo Tablet
rooms.description: Nine ancient sword marks ask for a response not of strength but of intent.

stygian_lantern_tomb.name: Stygian Lantern Tomb
stygian_lantern_tomb.description: A tomb that appears beneath old graves only when nine corpse-lanterns burn with blue fire.

rooms.name: Whispering Stair
rooms.description: The dead murmur truths and lies in equal measure while the staircase changes behind you.

rooms.name: Hall of Borrowed Faces
rooms.description: Funeral masks repeat the voices of people the intruder once knew.

rooms.name: River Without Water
rooms.description: A black river of memory must be crossed without surrendering identity to the dead.

rooms.name: Keeper's Seal
rooms.description: A lesser seal of the underworld floats above a coffin whose owner is still speaking.

unexpected_events.title: Sudden Spiritual Qi Storm
unexpected_events.description: The local spiritual currents overturn without warning, making cultivation dangerous but unusually rich.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Spirit resources swell while unstable currents unsettle settlements and local markets.

world_effect.history: A sudden spiritual qi storm enriched the local veins and disrupted ordinary life.

unexpected_events.title: Heavenly Herb Bloom
unexpected_events.description: A rare medicinal plant matures early under a brief heaven-and-earth phenomenon.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Medicinal abundance draws gatherers, raises resource prosperity, and temporarily shifts herb demand.

world_effect.history: A heavenly herb bloom drew medicine gatherers and enriched the region.

unexpected_events.title: A Wounded Wandering Senior
unexpected_events.description: A badly wounded cultivator appears where no traveler should be, refusing to reveal who is hunting them.

unexpected_events.title: Whisper of a Cursed Relic
unexpected_events.description: A buried object calls directly to the cultivator through dreams that last only a heartbeat.

unexpected_events.title: Spirit-Beast Migration
unexpected_events.description: Spirit beasts flee through the region in numbers, suggesting something stronger is moving behind them.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Fleeing beasts strain roads and food stores while beast materials enter local trade.

world_effect.history: A mass spirit-beast migration damaged roads, strained food stores, and flooded hunters' markets.

unexpected_events.title: A Medicinal Rift Opens
unexpected_events.description: Space folds around the scent of ancient medicine. A hidden grotto is opening.

unexpected_events.title: Nine Sword Echoes Ring
unexpected_events.description: Nine sword cries sound from nowhere, and a broken stone gate appears between the cliffs.

unexpected_events.title: Nine Corpse-Lanterns Ignite
unexpected_events.description: Blue corpse-fire appears beneath old graves. A tomb that should not exist is becoming reachable.

unexpected_events.title: Ancient Ruin Appears
unexpected_events.description: A hidden palace of broken pagodas rises from the cliffs, exposing a gate into an ancient sword grave.

unexpected_events.title: Heavenly Treasure Descends
unexpected_events.description: Golden clouds split as a sealed treasure falls from the heavens. Cultivators, clans, and hidden experts converge before anyone can identify it.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Spirit resources rise, but treasure-seekers destabilize the area and drive up demand.

world_effect.history: A heavenly treasure descended, enriching local spirit currents and drawing dangerous competition.

unexpected_events.title: Major Sect Recruitment
unexpected_events.description: A major sect delegation raises testing platforms and examines spiritual roots, physiques, bloodlines, discipline, and character.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Migration and recruitment pressure increase while sects spend resources competing for talent.

world_effect.history: Sect recruitment platforms drew ambitious youths and their families into the region.

unexpected_events.title: Beast Tide
unexpected_events.description: Thousands of demonic beasts surge from the wilderness toward walls, roads, farms, and spirit-resource sites.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The tide causes casualties, food shortages, migration, insecurity, and a regional market shock even without player intervention.

world_effect.history: A demonic beast tide struck the region, damaging settlements, roads, farms, and spirit-resource sites.

unexpected_events.title: Secret Inheritance Revealed
unexpected_events.description: A collapsed tomb reveals an ancient jade furnace and a trial-path leading toward a sealed inheritance chamber.

unexpected_events.title: Lightning Tribulation
unexpected_events.description: A nearby breakthrough summons layered heavenly lightning. Every bolt scars the land and enriches the surviving spirit currents.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Security falls around the strike zone while damaged terrain becomes unusually rich in spiritual energy.

world_effect.history: A cultivator's lightning tribulation scarred the land and transformed the local spiritual currents.

unexpected_events.title: Demonic Cultivator Incident
unexpected_events.description: An apparently ordinary settlement is exposed as the center of a forbidden ritual fed by missing travelers and stolen vitality.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The discovery raises unrest, reduces security, and disrupts nearby trade.

world_effect.history: A forbidden demonic ritual was exposed inside an ordinary settlement.

unexpected_events.title: Auction House Chaos
unexpected_events.description: A supposedly worthless lot reveals a hidden treasure aura. Bids explode, private rooms unseal, and every faction begins calculating who must not leave with it.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Auction speculation increases prosperity and unrest while distorting local prices and demand.

world_effect.history: A misidentified auction lot triggered a bidding war and intense faction speculation.

unexpected_events.title: Young Master Confrontation
unexpected_events.description: An arrogant heir takes offense over a seat, treasure, companion, beast, or even a patch of grass. Their retainers make certain the misunderstanding escalates spectacularly.

unexpected_events.title: Mysterious Old Beggar
unexpected_events.description: A ragged old beggar asks for food and courtesy. The pressure hidden behind their clouded eyes suggests an ancient expert testing character rather than wealth.

unexpected_events.title: Celestial Descendant in Disguise
unexpected_events.description: A quiet traveler with impossible manners and a concealed lineage asks seemingly ordinary questions while hidden guardians watch from beyond spiritual sense.

unexpected_events.title: Spatial Rift
unexpected_events.description: A crack in reality begins swallowing loose objects, beasts, and pieces of nearby structures. Blue lantern-light flickers beyond the tear.

unexpected_events.title: Ancient Bloodline Awakening
unexpected_events.description: A nearby cultivator suddenly manifests the aura of an ancient divine bloodline, causing dormant lineage marks in the crowd to tremble in response.

unexpected_events.title: Sect Tournament
unexpected_events.description: Sect disciples gather to fight for rankings, resources, weapons, prestige, and qualification for future secret-realm expeditions.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Visitors enrich the region while sect competition consumes resources and increases recruitment pressure.

world_effect.history: A sect tournament drew disciples, merchants, scouts, and rival elders into the region.

unexpected_events.title: Spirit Herb Mutation
unexpected_events.description: A common medicinal plant absorbs an abnormal qi current and transforms into a treasure with centuries of condensed vitality.

unexpected_events.title: Meteor from the Heavens
unexpected_events.description: A burning object crashes beyond the horizon. Within the crater may be an artifact, corpse, egg, sealed remnant, or imprisoned being.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The impact enriches spirit resources but damages security and draws treasure hunters.

world_effect.history: A heavenly meteor struck nearby, creating a resource-rich crater contested by treasure hunters.

unexpected_events.title: Ancient Soul Possession
unexpected_events.description: An ancient cultivator's remnant soul wakes inside an apparently ordinary person, leaking memories and a pressure that does not belong to this era.

player_effect.name: Remnant Soul Echo
player_effect.description: Foreign memories sharpen spiritual perception but strain the will.

unexpected_events.title: Demon Invasion
unexpected_events.description: Demonic forces cross a weakened boundary and attack settlements, sect outposts, resource sites, and transport routes.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Population, security, food, resources, sect treasuries, and market supply all suffer a severe persistent shock.

world_effect.history: A demonic invasion crossed into the region and overwhelmed settlements, roads, and sect defenses.

unexpected_events.title: Nine-Colored Heavenly Phenomenon
unexpected_events.description: Nine-colored clouds, golden lotuses, divine music, and impossible stars announce that someone nearby achieved an absurd breakthrough.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The phenomenon enriches local qi and attracts cultivators, merchants, and sect scouts.

world_effect.history: A nine-colored heavenly phenomenon announced an extraordinary breakthrough.

unexpected_events.title: Political Marriage Arrangement
unexpected_events.description: Two sects or martial clans attempt to bind bloodlines and interests through a political marriage. Every polite sentence conceals an alliance calculation.

unexpected_events.title: Cultivation Market Scam
unexpected_events.description: A merchant sells a cheap-looking object as worthless junk. Beneath the grime is a fragment of an ancient formation secret the seller never recognized.

unexpected_events.title: Time-Distortion Formation
unexpected_events.description: A damaged formation creates a pocket where hours outside feel like years of meditation inside, though memory and qi strain remain real.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The formation enriches local spatial qi; participants can claim a temporary cultivation afterglow once.

world_effect.history: A time-distortion formation destabilized local space and enriched spatial qi.

player_effect.name: Time-Distortion Afterglow
player_effect.description: Compressed meditation memories briefly improve cultivation efficiency.

unexpected_events.title: The Dead City
unexpected_events.description: Travelers find an entire city standing silent and intact, yet every inhabitant vanished overnight without signs of flight or battle.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Population collapses locally, trade avoids the region, and fear drives migration and unrest.

world_effect.history: An inhabited district became a dead city overnight, with its population missing and no clear cause.

unexpected_events.title: A Dragon Appears
unexpected_events.description: A true dragon descends through the clouds. Its intent is unreadable, its presence crushes weaker beasts, and it is very much not necessarily friendly.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The dragon's aura disrupts security and trade while awakening nearby spirit veins.

world_effect.history: A dragon appeared over the region, suppressing beasts and cultivators while awakening local spirit veins.

unexpected_events.title: Fate Encounter
unexpected_events.description: A stranger in need may later become a hidden expert, future ruler, reincarnator, benefactor, or terrifying enemy. The choice to help is recorded by fate.

unexpected_events.title: Heaven's Chosen Appears
unexpected_events.description: A ridiculously talented young cultivator arrives, shatters local records, attracts every sect's attention, and immediately becomes everyone's political problem.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: Sect recruitment and doctrine pressure rise as factions compete to claim or contain the prodigy.

world_effect.history: A Heaven's Chosen shattered local records and triggered fierce sect competition.

unexpected_events.title: Forbidden Zone Opens
unexpected_events.description: A prohibition seal that endured for thousands of years breaks. Corpse-lanterns reveal a route into the forbidden tomb below.

unexpected_events.title: Reincarnated Expert Awakens
unexpected_events.description: An unremarkable cultivator suddenly remembers a previous life, recognizes ancient techniques at a glance, and begins rebuilding with frightening efficiency.

unexpected_events.title: Artifact Chooses Its Master
unexpected_events.description: A legendary artifact rejects every acclaimed genius, then flies into the hands of the person nobody expected it to acknowledge.

unexpected_events.title: Heavenly Punishment
unexpected_events.description: An ancient rule is violated by accident. Dark clouds gather around the offender alone, and the heavens mark the debt before the first bolt falls.

player_effect.name: Heavenly Punishment Mark
player_effect.description: Heavenly pressure hinders cultivation and tests resolve until the mark fades.

unexpected_events.title: Cultivation World's Festival
unexpected_events.description: Cultivators gather for trading, poetry, music, drinking, friendly competitions, matchmaking, and the statistically inevitable trouble.
unexpected_events.consequence_text: The festival improves prosperity and security while increasing trade, demand, and sect recruitment.

world_effect.history: A cultivation festival filled the region with trade, performances, competitions, and new alliances.

quests.title: Skin Without Flaw
quests.description: Temper the outer body until ordinary weakness has nowhere left to hide in your {realm}.

quests.title: Bones Like Spirit Iron
quests.description: Reforge the framework of the body through pressure, impact, and medicinal tempering.
quests.clue: A body that fears pain can never become unbreakable.

quests.title: Twelve Meridian Furnace
quests.description: Drive blood and body essence through every major meridian without tearing them.
quests.clue: The meridians are roads; perfection demands that none remain narrow.

quests.title: Blood Roars Like Thunder
quests.description: Condense vitality until each heartbeat carries the force of your cultivation path.
quests.clue: Blood is not merely life; it is the army that carries life.

quests.title: Marrow Rebirth
quests.description: Purge old weakness from the deepest parts of the body and regrow stronger marrow.
quests.clue: To be reborn, the old body must first be surpassed.

quests.title: Body and Dao in Accord
quests.description: Use insight to make your physical form resonate with the principles you cultivate.
quests.clue: The strongest body is one that agrees with its Dao.

quests.title: A Worthy Vessel
quests.description: Prove through battle, hardship, or impossible exertion that your body can contain greater power.
quests.clue: Power without a vessel becomes self-destruction.

sect_system.resource_policy: Sect members donate materials for contribution points. Higher ranks and accumulated influence determine political weight; contribution points can be exchanged for stocked sect resources.

recruitment.description: Applicants demonstrate stable foundations, qi control and the judgment expected of an orthodox sword sect.
Applicants identify medicinal materials, stabilize furnace flame and prove that their qi will not ruin a batch under pressure.
Applicants cross a cold formation while preserving clarity, restraint and precise control of spiritual energy.

Black Serpent Clan.specialty: Poisons, beast blood and ambush arts

recruitment.description: Applicants navigate venomous terrain, read beast behavior and prove they can survive without wasting valuable creatures.

Blood River Sect.specialty: Blood refinement, sacrificial arts and battlefield harvesting

recruitment.description: Only invited or discovered applicants reach the gorge. The test values survival instinct, resolve and willingness to bear the consequences of a hunted path.

Corpse Lantern Pavilion.specialty: Soul lanterns, corpse refinement, ghost techniques and forbidden inscriptions

recruitment.description: Invited applicants keep vigil among bound memories and must distinguish fear, grief and spiritual deception without losing their own identity.

golden_pavilion.name: Golden Pavilion Auction House
golden_pavilion.description: Violence is suppressed by formations and hidden guards inside. Once a bidder leaves through the doors, the Pavilion no longer guarantees protection.

folded_step.name: Folded Step
folded_step.description: Fold a short span of space to reposition instantly.

spatial_lockdown.name: Spatial Lockdown
spatial_lockdown.description: Freeze local space around an opponent, suppressing movement and escape.

spatial_strangulation.name: Spatial Strangulation
spatial_strangulation.description: Compress the space surrounding a target into a crushing prison.

space_domain.name: Space Dominion
space_domain.description: Project a domain in which the user controls distance, direction, and spatial stability.

world_collapse.name: World Collapse
world_collapse.description: Use a stabilized personal world as a conceptual weapon against another domain.

spatial_lockdown.name: Spatial Lockdown
spatial_lockdown.description: Local space is frozen. Movement, flight, and escape are suppressed.

spatial_strangulation.name: Spatial Strangulation
spatial_strangulation.description: Space compresses inward, bypassing ordinary physical positioning and crushing the target.

space_domain.name: Space Dominion
space_domain.description: Within this domain, distance and direction bend toward the cultivator’s will.

abode_cultivation_focus.name: Cave Abode Cultivation Focus
abode_cultivation_focus.description: A stabilized cultivation chamber improves local qi circulation.

forge_inspiration.name: Forge Inspiration
forge_inspiration.description: The private forge and formation-fed furnace improve forging control.

alchemy_inspiration.name: Alchemy Inspiration
alchemy_inspiration.description: A private medicine room improves flame and medicinal-energy control.

cave_abode.name: Cave Abode
cave_abode.description: A secluded cultivation residence balanced around cultivation, storage and formations.

alchemy_estate.name: Alchemy Estate
alchemy_estate.description: A private estate centered on pill refinement, medicinal herbs and secure storage.

spirit_herb_estate.name: Spirit Herb Estate
spirit_herb_estate.description: A spiritual garden estate specializing in herb cultivation and medicinal preparation.

spirit_beast_ranch.name: Spirit Beast Ranch
spirit_beast_ranch.description: A protected private holding for contracted beasts, training and recovery.

merchant_pavilion.name: Merchant Pavilion
merchant_pavilion.description: A player-owned commercial residence with expanded storage and merchant facilities.

clan_estate.name: Clan Estate
clan_estate.description: A fortified family estate suited to cultivation, guests, formations and long-term clan scenes.

forbidden_arts.description: Blood, soul-devouring, corpse, sacrificial and predatory cultivation arts are forbidden by most orthodox jurisdictions. Public use creates evidence and political consequences; demonic factions may approve of the same act.

family_principles: Families protect bloodline survival and reputation before abstract ideology.
A publicly exposed forbidden cultivator can cost their family alliances, stability and face.
Powerful families may hide a useful demonic heir while weak families may disown them to survive.
Blood feuds and succession crises persist across player deaths and reincarnations.
npc_principles: NPCs act according to faction, fear, ambition, memory and local law rather than player convenience.
Orthodox witnesses can report forbidden arts; demonic witnesses may respect or recruit the user.
NPC death is canonical and may weaken families, sects, markets and regional security.
sect_principles: Orthodox sects punish exposed forbidden arts unless leadership chooses secrecy or expediency.
Demonic sects reward effective forbidden cultivation but punish weakness and resource waste.
Sect policy, cohesion, resources and internal factions continue changing during player seclusion.

blood_sea_scripture.name: Blood Sea Scripture
blood_sea_scripture.description: Refines blood essence into violent crimson qi. Fast, potent, and corrosive to the Dao Heart.

soul_devouring_codex.name: Soul-Devouring Codex
soul_devouring_codex.description: A forbidden soul path that tears loose fragments of spiritual consciousness.

white_bone_demon_manual.name: White Bone Demon Manual
white_bone_demon_manual.description: Tempers bones with corpse-yin and death qi until the body resembles an undead treasure.

ten_thousand_venoms_record.name: Ten Thousand Venoms Record
ten_thousand_venoms_record.description: Turns poisons into cultivation resources and the body into a mobile poison furnace.

heart_demon_whispering_art.name: Heart-Demon Whispering Art
heart_demon_whispering_art.description: Invades fear, regret and obsession to cultivate power from another being’s inner demons.

netherworld_sacrificial_sutra.name: Netherworld Sacrificial Sutra
netherworld_sacrificial_sutra.description: Burns vitality, lifespan and karmic fortune for terrifying temporary strength.

blood_sea_palm.name: Blood Sea Palm
blood_sea_palm.description: A palm strike carrying corrosive blood qi.

scarlet_rebirth.name: Scarlet Rebirth
scarlet_rebirth.description: Burns blood essence to force wounds closed.

soul_rend.name: Soul Rend
soul_rend.description: A spiritual tear aimed directly at the opponent’s soul.

ghost_lantern_bind.name: Ghost Lantern Bind
ghost_lantern_bind.description: Ghost-fire chains suppress the target’s actions.

white_bone_claw.name: White Bone Claw
white_bone_claw.description: Corpse-yin hardens the fingers into tearing bone claws.

corpse_armor.name: Corpse Armor
corpse_armor.description: Death qi temporarily seals flesh and deadens pain.

black_miasma_finger.name: Black Miasma Finger
black_miasma_finger.description: Condenses poisonous qi into a piercing finger strike.

venomous_meridian_seal.name: Venomous Meridian Seal
venomous_meridian_seal.description: Poison qi clogs the target’s meridian circulation.

heart_demon_whisper.name: Heart-Demon Whisper
heart_demon_whisper.description: A whisper that turns unresolved fear into a weapon.

seven_emotion_collapse.name: Seven-Emotion Collapse
seven_emotion_collapse.description: Overloads the seven emotions until mind and qi collapse together.

life_burning_demon_flame.name: Life-Burning Demon Flame
life_burning_demon_flame.description: Sacrifices life force to ignite black-red demonic flame.

netherworld_descent.name: Netherworld Descent
netherworld_descent.description: Briefly overlays the battlefield with a predatory netherworld domain.
